CompactLogix  
5390 Controller
Features and benefits
• High-performance processing for complex,  
multi axis and high-speed applications
• Footprint reduction and optimized thermal performance 
for smaller panels and tighter machine layouts
• Built-in cybersecurity aligned to IEC 62443 4 2, CIP 
Security, Syslog and Cyber Resiliency Act readiness
• Integrated safety helps ensure reliability, preventing 
hazards through functional safety and cybersecurity
• Dual EtherNet/IP ports for enhanced communication 
options: Dual IP address, DLR, Star and linear
• 1 Gbps front ports and 1 Gbps backplane for high-speed 
data movement
• USB C connectivity for modern configuration  
and service workflows
• OPC UA-enabled for more secure information exchange
• Scaling levers based on memory
• Local I/O support with PointMax™  I/O, Bulletin 5034, for 
up to 32 I/O modules in any combination
• Lower power consumption and durable construction 
using recycled materials
The CompactLogix® 5390 Controller gives 
manufacturers and OEMs a powerful new platform to 
build redefined architectures for high performance, 
space efficient and data driven machines. Its 
dramatically reduced footprint opens the door to 
smaller, more flexible designs without sacrificing 
capability, while local I/O support with PointMax 
I/O simplifies wiring and accelerates build time. 
With enhanced communication throughput, the 
CompactLogix 5390 Controller helps OEMs deliver 
machines that provide richer diagnostics, faster 
insights and more value to End Users. 
Built in cybersecurity aligned to global standards 
helps ensure that every machine is ready for today’s 
regulatory landscape and tomorrow’s evolving 
requirements. By integrating performance, security, 
safety and compact design, the CompactLogix 5390 
Controller enables OEMs to innovate faster, differentiate 
their machines and streamline development and 
deployment. For end users, it delivers smarter, more 
resilient operations with the flexibility to adapt to 
changing production demands.
